description: Shows every webhook Trickl sent for a sandbox goal, newest first, with its payload and the receiver's result. DELIVERED = got a 2xx. FAILED = rejected, retry scheduled at nextRetryAt. EXHAUSTED = gave up. PENDING / DELIVERING = in flight; check again in a few seconds. Use lastStatusCode and lastError to debug the receiver.
name: list_webhook_deliveries
title: List webhook deliveries
